title: Single trace object, discreteness of the winding phase, and the Lean formalisation
html:
Remark. Single trace object, discreteness of the winding phase, and the Lean formalisation

A single trace object

The embeddable strand counts dictate a single trace algebra H_2(q) \oplus H_3(q) carrying 2+3=5 irreducible representations (prop:cohomological-embedding). These match Bring's five homogeneous coordinates, partitioned into a rank-two spacetime block and a rank-three color block (brings-qou-4tuple). We record the color content of an embedded photon as an element of H_3(q), where the generators \sigma_0, \sigma_1 serve as the color axes (knot-basis-color-content). Color therefore provides a grading on the trace algebra itself, rather than a separate object.

The substrate symmetry S_5 acts on all five coordinates. Its block-diagonal subgroup S_2 \times S_3 permutes spacetime and color separately. The S_3 permutes the three color sheets while preserving spacetime (color-sector-coords, rem:chirality-trefoil). The S_2 permutes the two spacetime coordinates while preserving color. Parts (1) and (2) formalize this. The product embeds faithfully, and each factor fixes the opposing sector pointwise. Color and spacetime function as independent coordinates on a single object. They couple only through S_5 elements outside S_2 \times S_3, which rotate spacetime indices into color indices.

Discreteness

Part (3) enforces rigidity on the continuous sector. The connected group \mathbb{R} is divisible, so any homomorphism to a finite group G vanishes. For each x, f(x) = f\big(|G| \cdot \tfrac{x}{|G|}\big) = |G| \cdot f(\tfrac{x}{|G|}) = 0, because |G| \cdot g = 0 for every g \in G. A continuous winding parameter cannot carry a finite-group (e.g. \mu_5) character. Physically, this dictates that the continuous trace phase does not constitute the discrete color charge (rem:mass-modulus-em-phase-color-grading).

Lean formalism

These claims are formalized without sorry in QOU.MassEndomorphism via spacetime_color_card, colorSpacetimeEmbed_injective, color_fixes_spacetime, spacetime_fixes_color, and winding_hom_to_finite_trivial. The construction is generic. The embedding and divisibility arguments rely strictly on combinatorial data, requiring no archimedean input.
